QuestionStmt.S: Three inductances are connected as shown in the figure. The equivalent inductance between A and B is

Solution.S:
Two 0.7 H inductors are in parallel.

$$\frac{1}{L_p} = \frac{1}{0.7} + \frac{1}{0.7} = \frac{2}{0.7} \Rightarrow L_p = \frac{0.7}{2} = 0.35 \text{ H}$$

This parallel combination is in series with the 0.85 H inductor.

$$L_{eq} = L_p + 0.85 = 0.35 + 0.85 = 1.20 \text{ H}$$

Thus the equivalent inductance between A and B is 1.20 H, which corresponds to option B.
